reason: The README describes a workspace-scoped long-term memory plugin with approval-gated fact management, session-history search, citations, and profile recall as its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按工作区管理的长期记忆，包括经审批的事实写入、跨会话搜索、引用溯源和配置文件召回。
summaries.en: Provides workspace-scoped long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with approval-gated fact management, cross-session search, provenance citations, and profile recall.

capabilities: Stores and updates workspace-scoped memory facts
Reads and searches past session logs
Exports masked memory to a Markdown file
Displays memory in a read-only browser page
Optionally proposes session-end memory candidates using one LLM call
